problem.title: Exclusive Time of Functions
problem.problemStatement: A single-threaded CPU executes n functions identified by IDs from 0 to n-1. Execution logs are provided in the format: function_id:start_or_end:timestamp A function may call another function before finishing. Return the exclusive execution time of each function, excluding the time spent executing child functions.
problem.input: Integer n Integer m Array of m log strings.
problem.output: An array of n integers representing the exclusive execution time of each function.
problem.constraints: 1 <= n <= 100 1 <= m <= 500 Logs are valid and sorted by timestamp.
